scope: Nanoflow data actions in the exported TypeScript runtime

native.toolchain: Linux MxBuild portable app, Mendix Runtime and headless Chromium via script/client_native_oracle

corpus_impact: 49 of 183 nanoflows in the public corpus and the SPC project used Retrieve, ListOperations, Rollback, Delete, Aggregate, Commit or loops
native_semantics: database retrieves sort strings without case and place empty values first
the client list Sort places empty values last in both directions
Average of an empty list is empty, Sum is 0, Minimum/Maximum empty
Find and Filter by expression bind $currentObject
fixed: nanoflow log messages printed {1} instead of the parameter value
limitations: retrieves over associations of uncommitted objects and generalization-aware association direction are not covered
list Equals and reduce operations are rejected
